nodes.description: ZNF407 is annotated as a Kruppel-type C2H2 zinc-finger protein. Structural modeling of the biallelic p.S1685W allele predicts impaired target-DNA binding, while experiments in mouse adipocytes demonstrate ZFP407 cofactor activity in a non-neural context. Neither result directly establishes the molecular consequence of a disease allele in human neural cells; the extent of impairment and relevant neural targets remain unknown.
